newsitem.title: USA: AMEX, PCX to trade options on Rhone-Poulenc ADRs.
newsitem.headline: AMEX, PCX to trade options on Rhone-Poulenc ADRs.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) and the Pacific Exchange (PCX) said Wednesday they would begin trading options on American Depositary Receipts of Rhone-Poulenc SA on August 1.
The exchanges said the options will have opening strikes of 35, 40 and 45, position limits of 7,500 contracts and initial expirations in August, September, October and January.

At the AMEX, the specialist will be Highland Securities and at the PCX, the options have been allocated to pit reps Glenn Gsell and Ross Goodheart. The options will also be available at the Chicago Board Options Exchange.
